system.title: Mai tsaftace faifan C:
system.subtitle: Share manyan fayilolin wucin gadi na Windows, bayanan Prefetch da ragowar sabuntawa. Ba a taɓa taɓa ayyukanka, takardunka ko Abubuwan da aka sauke ba.
system.adminBody: Windows yana toshe manyan fayilolin tsari ga masu amfani na yau da kullum. Sake kunna manhajar a matsayin mai gudanarwa don tsaftace su; za a kiyaye zaɓinka.
system.restartAdmin: Sake kunnawa a matsayin mai gudanarwa
system.elevated: Yana gudana a matsayin mai gudanarwa
system.confirmBody: Za a cire su dindindin, ba za a kai su Kwandon Shara ba. Abubuwan da aka yi wa alama masu sake ginawa Windows zai sake gina su ta atomatik.
system.stopAfterStep: Tsaya bayan matakin Windows na yanzu
system.automatedBody: Mai tsara ayyukan Windows yana gudanar da tsaftacewa mai sauri bisa jadawali, da mafi girman haƙƙin da asusunka ya ba da izini kuma ba tare da tambaya ba. Manhajar tana iya cire aikin a kowane lokaci.
system.scheduleInstalled: An girka aikin da aka tsara
system.scheduleMissing: Windows ba shi da aiki don wannan jadawalin. Sake adanawa don gyara shi.
system.cleanmgrBody: Buɗe kayan tsaftace faifai na asali na Windows ko saita kuma gudanar da bayanin martaba 1 da aka adana ba tare da rubuta umarnin CMD ba.
system.cleanmgrLaunched: An ƙaddamar da Tsaftacewar Faifan Windows.

onboarding.title: Barka da zuwa Detergo
onboarding.step1Body: Bincika kuma dawo da sararin diski cikin aminci a ayyukan shirye-shirye, wakilan AI, ma'ajiyar fakiti, da rumbun Windows C: - 100% a gida.
onboarding.step1Card1Desc: Node.js, Rust, Python, Java, .NET, Go, Flutter, Docker, da sauransu.
onboarding.step1Card2Desc: Bincika Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, npm, Cargo, da pip cikin aminci.
onboarding.step1Card3Desc: Komai yana zama a na'urarka. Babu asusu, babu bin diddigi, bude tushe.
onboarding.step2Title: An Gina Don Rashin Asarar Bayanai
onboarding.step2Body: Kowane aikin tsaftacewa yana wucewa ta tabbatarwa mai tsauri kafin a taba koda byte daya.
onboarding.step2Item1Desc: Abubuwan da aka zaba suna komawa Windows Recycle Bin domin ka iya dawo da su kowane lokaci.
onboarding.step2Item2Title: Kariya daga symlink da makullai masu aiki
onboarding.step2Item2Desc: Wuraren tura hanya da fayilolin da ginawa mai gudana ya kulle ana kare su ta atomatik.
onboarding.step2Item3Desc: Duba ainihin hanyoyi, girma, da alamun aminci kafin tabbatar da kowane tsaftacewar aiki ko C:.
onboarding.step3Body: Zabi yarenka, dauki jigo na asali ko launin hex na musamman, kuma saita matakin zumi mai dadi.
onboarding.step4Body: Fara da binciken gamayya daga Takaitawa, ko sarrafa tsaftacewa ta atomatik daga terminal da kayan AI.
onboarding.step4Tip1: Yi amfani da 'Bincika komai' a gefen shafi don duba Ayyuka, Kayan AI, da Ma'ajiya tare.
onboarding.step4Tip2: Danna Ctrl + / Ctrl - / Ctrl 0 kowane lokaci don daidaita zumin fuska.
onboarding.step4Tip3: Gudanar da 'detergo s .' a terminal ko hada 'detergo mcp' da AI IDE dinka.
